skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Glory of the Devout
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Glory of the Devout. Nun's habit that has been altered, with adjustments for the wearer's racial characteristics. Paired with accessories that reflect one's personal style.
skins.quote: The clerics of Landen Monastery haven't worn the traditional habit as daily attire in quite a while, but on days that require hymn-singing and pious vows, they take the time to put them on and gather in the chapel, for the sake of a beautiful dream that all have partaken in for ages past.

skins.name: Publicity Strategy
skins.content: Monster Siren Records Idol Project 'Shining Steps' Promotional Costume/Publicity Strategy. The cloistered idol Hildegard, appearing with the sponsorship from MountainDash Logistics, sings the praises of Landen Monstery in a modern, fashionable way.
skins.quote: Some of her cleric sisters off stage have to hold in their laughter at the fact that Hildegard's up there singing a prayer.
